voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Liverpool, England. March, eighteen fifty-four. The iron steamship City of Glasgow sailed for Philadelphia with more than four hundred people aboard.
Most were emigrants in steerage. She never arrived, and no word of her ever came.
That month, her sister ship met icebergs and wide fields of ice. Other ships called it the worst in years. Ice is one theory. Only a theory.
In May, her owners accepted she was lost. No one aboard was ever seen again.
Wreckage was reported more than once. None was ever proven hers. Her wreck has never been found.
